purpose: Independent numeric Deflektor motion components; caller scheduling and complete note setup are separate.

data.scalarDomain: All parameters/state fields are uint8 except word, which is uint16; booleans reject. States/programs are frozen dataclasses and numeric mappings remain unchanged.
data.jsonMappingKeys: Convert numeric JSON object keys with int(key) before supplying a Python table mapping.
data.sourceAliases: PWM base32 and pitch selector8 use the same motion-table cells32..39. The extracted resonance view also overlaps motion cells132..279 at resonance indices0..147; extraction preserves equal source bytes, while each API receives an explicit editable mapping.
data.disabled: Zero interval/selector retains the validated state and performs no table lookup.
data.unsupported: Missing/non-byte numeric table entries and non-terminating PWM marker cycles reject. Synthetic table bytes are interpreted by the verified arithmetic, not inferred as musical notes.

callerRules: Invoke continuing motion only after caller body admission; row boundaries, rests and global suppression are external decisions.
Note initialization supplies the newly selected frequency word. Enabled pitch initialization loads its wait and position1 without changing the word.
Patch selection resets resonance position0 before any note initializer, retaining its countdown. Note initialization may then replace countdown/position.
Compose one shared resonance shadow in voice0, voice1, voice2 order. Each enabled update changes only high nibble, preserving incoming routing low bits.
PWM, delayed pitch and resonance compute RAM shadows, not SID stores. The ordered writer is a separate component.

sourceEvidence.observedScope: PWM/pitch comparisons seed each incoming state from the retained complete source execution. Resonance carries independent local timers/positions and shared shadow across calls0..8480, but source evidence supplies selectors and row/patch actions. Mutation controls change inputs against those contexts, not a rerun of an edited original driver.
sourceEvidence.runtimeBoundary: Source addresses, paths, CPU instructions, events and verification hashes are provenance only. Pure helpers consume named state and numeric table cells; no original driver or captured event/register replay is a runtime dependency.
